name: CT Chest (CTPA) — Pulmonary Embolism Protocol
description: CT pulmonary angiography template for suspected pulmonary embolism. Emphasizes pulmonary arteries, heart strain, lungs/pleura, mediastinum, and incidental findings.

fields.name: technique
fields.label: Technique
fields.description: CT protocol, contrast usage, phases if relevant.

fields.name: comparison
fields.label: Comparison
fields.description: Prior studies and dates if mentioned, otherwise none.

fields.name: findings_pulmonary_arteries
fields.label: Findings — Pulmonary Arteries
fields.description: Describe presence/absence of filling defects and distribution (main/lobar/segmental/subsegmental).

fields.name: findings_heart
fields.label: Findings — Heart/Great Vessels
fields.description: Right heart strain signs if described, heart size, aorta if noted.

fields.name: findings_lungs
fields.label: Findings — Lungs/Airways
fields.description: Consolidation, atelectasis, nodules, edema, airway findings if mentioned.

fields.name: findings_mediastinum
fields.label: Findings — Mediastinum/Lymph Nodes
fields.description: Adenopathy or mediastinal findings if mentioned.

fields.name: impression
fields.label: Impression
fields.description: Concise key diagnoses and relevant negatives. Do not invent findings.
